set.name: neo4j properties that are also fields
set.title: Neo4j Properties That Are Also Fields
set.description: Fields of a concept that its elements also carry on their Neo4j nodes. Each element is the field's property node, from its concept's property tree. graph mark-field adds one and copies the field's value from each element's JSON to the node property <concept key>_<field>; graph unmark-field takes it out and removes the copies; graph map-fields brings the copies up to date.
